summary: Pivot to specific benchmarks to find empirical data on dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets, adhering to strict source limits.
body: Previous attempts failed to find controlled experiments matching resource constraints. We must now target specific, reproducible benchmarks (e.g., LongMemEval) to gather descriptive evidence on how dynamic consolidation policies perform against static baselines like append-only, measuring task success and hallucination rates within identical token limits. Limit to 4 sources; do not implement code. If no 4 sources meet criteria, revise scope to match available evidence.
